system.uid.note: Third ID word read from offset 0x14 (was 0x08, not part of the ID, RM0377 §28.2): fixed 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

system.recovery.note: No USB, so no ROM DFU path to park in

system.swo.note: Cortex-M0+ has no ITM/SWO; hal_debug_printf is a no-op

system.wamr.note: WAMR builds target the Cortex-M33 Cores only (Makefile WAMR_ENABLED guard); 2 KB SRAM

clocks.hsi.note: 'high' now selects voltage range 1 (the L0 boots in range 2, where 16 MHz needs 1 WS) and ramps MSI 4.2 MHz -> HSI16 for the VDD < 2 V step rule (RM0377 §6.1.4). Changed 2026-09-25, awaiting bench (tests/hw-clock-levels)

clocks.msi.note: The hang was MSIRDY: the L0 polled RCC_CR bit 1 (HSI16KERON), MSIRDY is bit 9 (RM0377 §7.3.1). Fixed 2026-09-25, plus exact MSI frequencies in SYSCLK_HZ (1.048576 / 2.097152 MHz; SysTick ran ~5 % fast), 'low' in voltage range 3 (range 2 with I2C) and no out-of-spec LPRUN. Awaiting bench (tests/hw-clock-levels)

clocks.pll.note: 'max' ran the PLL VCO at 128 MHz in range 2 (limits 96 MHz in range 1, 48 in range 2, RM0377 §7.2.4); now HSI16 x4 /2 (VCO 64 MHz) in range 1 at 1 WS. Changed 2026-09-25, awaiting bench (tests/hw-clock-levels)

uart.lp.note: LPUART1 bus clock was never enabled (RCC_APB1ENR bit 18, RM0377 §7.3.14). Fixed 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

i2c.std.note: I2C1 kernel clock is HSI16 (RCC_CCIPR.I2C1SEL) at every clock level, so 100/400 kHz timing no longer depends on SYSCLK; bus recovery now uses PB6/PB7 (it drove PA9/PA10). 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

i2c.fast.note: 400 kHz at the MSI levels (the default project + an I2C tile failed to build: 'requires at least 4 MHz'); HSI16 kernel clock, restarted after Stop. 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

timer.wdog.note: Starved-refresh reset verified earlier, but the timeout assumed a 32 kHz LSI; the L0's is 37 kHz nominal (26-56 kHz, DS table 39), so the 5 s watchdog fired at ~4.3 s. Prescaler scaled per family (LL_LSI_HZ), fixed 2026-09-25 (RM0377), awaiting bench. Not calibrated against HSI16, so the timeout still varies part to part.

adc.raw.note: Verified at the HSI16 clock levels (asynchronous HSI16 ADC clock, unchanged). The MSI levels had no ADC clock at all; since 2026-09-25 they use PCLK/2 (LFMEN below 3.5 MHz), compile-only

adc.mv.note: VREFINT was never enabled on the L0 before 2026-09-22 (VREFEN written to reserved CFGR2 bits), so earlier readings were ~9x off. Fixed; VDDA now reads 3292 mV on a ~3.3 V rail. Re-verify with known input voltages.

adc.temp.note: Reads sensor; factory cal at 0x1FF8007A — value offset needs investigation

adc.dma_mv.note: Scan-to-millivolt chain verified on silicon 2026-09-22; absolute accuracy not yet checked against known input voltages.

power.stop.note: The hang was not the wakeup path: the LSI helpers set LSEON (RCC_CSR bit 8) and waited forever on LSERDY; LSE/LSI bits were swapped. Fixed 2026-09-25 (register map per RM0377 §7.3.20; WUF cleared before each Stop per Table 39; RTC wake vector enabled under PRIMASK; sleeps in fed chunks while the watchdog runs, which the L0 cannot freeze in Stop; an Alarm A routed to EXTI 17 is masked during the sleep so its pend can't turn Stop into a busy-wait), awaiting bench (tests/hw-sleep-cycle)

power.standby.note: Same LSI fix as power.stop, plus WUTF cleared before entry (RM0377 Table 40). Refuses (HAL_ERROR) a Standby longer than half the watchdog timeout, since the L0 IWDG keeps running in Standby. Fixed 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

power.rtc_wake.note: RTC wakeup timer on LSI (37 kHz nominal), EXTI line 20 + NVIC vector 2. Fixed 2026-09-25 (RM0377), awaiting bench (tests/hw-sleep-cycle)

power.exti_wake.note: core_stop_until_on_change waits for the pad edge itself, wakes to feed a running watchdog, returns at once if the pad is already at its wake level, and core_stop_until_on_change_timeout() bounds the wait (RTC-measured). 2026-09-25, awaiting bench

power.rtc_alarm.note: Alarm A (ALRMAR 0x1C, ALRAWF) was unreachable while the RTC clock init hung on the LSE. Fixed 2026-09-25 (register map per RM0377 §7.3.20 / §22.7), awaiting bench (tests/hw-sleep-cycle T2)

power.backup.note: 5 backup registers (RTC_BKP0R-4R at RTC+0x50, RM0377 §22.7.20); the RTC-clock bring-up they need hung on the LSE. Fixed 2026-09-25, awaiting bench (tests/hw-sleep-cycle T1)

adv.comp.note: L011 has COMP1/COMP2 but not routed on Core.ST.L0.1 pinout

nvm.eeprom.note: Writes step up from voltage range 3 (clock 'low') to range 2 for the program and back, since range 3 can't program the EEPROM (RM0377 §6.1.4). 2026-09-25

nvm.otp.note: The STM32L011 has no OTP area (it has data EEPROM, see nvm.eeprom)
